accounts:
# accounts.example.yaml — authz.mode: cert_dn
authz:
  mode: cert_dn
  client_dn_header: X-Client-Cert-DN

accounts:
  "CN=users-admin,OU=tuz,O=Acme,C=RU":
    grants:
      users:
        operations: [list, get, create, update, patch, delete]
        fields:
          read: [id, email, full_name, status, created_at, deleted_at]
          write: [email, full_name, status]
resource:
# config.yaml — resources.users
resources:
  users:
    table: users
    soft_delete:
      enabled: true
      field: deleted_at
    operations:
      list: true
      get: true
      create: true
      update: true
      patch: true
      delete: true
      upsert: true
      batch_create: true
    filterable: [email, full_name, status]
    upsert_keys: [tenant_id, email]
